{{Quote|I recognize the layout of this place. It's an old swoop racing track. Wish I had a Skybird Mark Three to ride around this in&hellip;|Corso Riggs|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Skybird Mark Three''' was a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] model that was available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
